score_evidence.A: Coherent arc: TL;DR (L11), problem and positioning (L19), concepts on actors (L61), request path/router (L153), composition (L255), autoscaling/backpressure (L469), first run (L562), FastAPI/streaming (L639), frameworks (L736), Serve LLM (L844), config file and build/deploy (L927), KubeRay/proxy (L1048), observability (L1111), when to choose (L1184). Deductions: description is 114 characters (L5; the rule is 120-160); category 'Language-Models' for a general serving guide is a stretch (L6); Sources has HTML entity leaks '|' and '[Serve]' (L1239-1240); install command repeated verbatim (L74 and L571).
score_evidence.B: Mostly natural Korean in a consistent 입니다 register. Formulaic sentences: L122 '개념 사이의 관계를 정리하면 다음과 같습니다(이해를 돕기 위한 예시입니다).' -> '두 디플로이먼트의 관계는 아래와 같습니다.'; L475 '동작 원리는 하나로 요약됩니다.' -> drop the frame and state the rule. Table cells forced into 입니다 (L462 '동기 제너레이터로 소비하기입니다', L463 '해당 없습니다') -> noun phrases ('동기 제너레이터로 소비', '없음'). Code comments switch to 한다 (L589-590 '붙여 넣는다', L700 '추가한다'). Repeated '~편이 안전합니다' (L251, L491, L1121).
score_evidence.C: Running example threads cleanly; cross-reference at L620 to the composition section is accurate; L167 points forward correctly. Minor: the 'generated' serve_config.yaml (L941-961) shows Translator num_replicas 1, which contradicts the post's own Translator (num_replicas=2 at L85), and the later autoscaling edit (L509) is described against that number.
score_evidence.D: Good help where it matters: Power of Two Choices worked example (L192), prefix-tree routing example (L247), 24/2=12 autoscaling example (L511), cancellation semantics (L692), drain timing (L1095, L1109), histogram bucket example (L1180). Over-explains the trivial: a six-row table plus a formula for a doubling backoff (L224-239).
score_evidence.E: Useful tables (autoscaling defaults L479, response types L459, proxy env vars L1088, Ray paper table L146) and ASCII diagrams labelled as illustrative (L39, L124, L169, L1103). Deductions: Triton vs Ray Serve table (L1202-1206) is not copied verbatim: row 'Model management' renamed '라우팅과 조합', and Triton cells replaced by '—' although the source fills them ('Centralized model repository, versioning, ensembles...', 'Preconfigured deployment patterns with autoscaling on GPUs...'); redundant backoff table plus formula (L226-239).
score_evidence.F: Wrong: (1) L509 'num_replicas: 1이 남아 있으면 serve deploy가 거절합니다' - on Ray 2.60.0 a config with Translator num_replicas: 1 over code with autoscaling_config was accepted ('Sent deploy request successfully', app RUNNING). (2) L1192/L1212 claims credited to 'Suhas Bhairav의 블로그 글(날짜 표기 없음)' (replica-per-actor state, Train/Tune/Data integration, KServe comparisons) are absent from the cited Suhas page, which is dated 'Published June 11, 2026'; the content credited to 'W2 페이지' (dynamic routing, actor-style state, Triton table, hybrid, failure modes) is the cited Suhas page. (3) Triton table cells (L1205-1206) replaced by '—'. (4) Generated serve_config.yaml (L941-961) differs from real 'serve build text_ml:app' output (app name 'app1', Translator num_replicas: 2 with ray_actor_options). Citation gaps: the Anyscale blog (L243, L251) and 'W2 페이지' (L1192, L1200, L1216) are not in Sources. Note: keep-alive '기본 5초' (L734) matches the http-guide text but Ray 2.60.0 code default is 90 s (HTTPOptions.keep_alive_timeout_s); BackpressureConfig status_code is limited to 503 (default) or 429, which L523 does not say.
score_evidence.T1: Running example actually runs: text_ml:app returned French ('C'était le meilleur des temps, c'était le pire des temps,'); FastAPI /text/summarize and /text/stream, the no-await pipeline, and user_config language switch to German all worked on a local cluster. Deductions: the RequestRouterConfig block (L198-218) raises ModuleNotFoundError (pyarrow) with only ray[serve] installed because the string router path imports ray.serve.llm; ray[serve,llm] is introduced only at L861. text_ml.py skeleton relies on paste-in comments (L589-590), and the streaming block (L696-712) needs manual placement of its imports.
score_evidence.T2: Covers the sources' important topics in a sensible order (concepts, composition, HTTP, config/deploy, KubeRay, monitoring). Padding: the RFC section on a proposed metrics path (L548-560) and the Serve LLM section (L844-925) go beyond the input getting-started scope; the examples-list paragraph (L842) is a catalogue.
score_evidence.T3: Strong internals: actor/replica model, request router and backoff, prefix-aware routing design and rejected alternative, handle/response semantics, cancellation, autoscaler fields and policy hooks, backpressure, proxy health/drain, metric export pipeline, plus when-to-choose and failure modes. Older Ray paper scheduler is named as the paper's design (L136).
